instruction: There are three mountain pictures in my Pictures directory. Please identify what mountains they are and create a text file named 'mountain_names.txt' in the Documents folder listing all three mountain names.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying mountains in three pictures and creating a text file listing their names. The evaluator reads the text file and checks if it contains all three mountain names (with partial credit: 0.33 per mountain). Acceptable variations include: Kilimanjaro/Kili/Mount Kilimanjaro, Everest/Mount Everest/Sagarmatha/Chomolungma, and Hua/Mount Hua/Huashan.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.33 for Kilimanjaro found, 0.67 for Everest found, 1.0 for all three mountains found
